inputs.note: Scanned r3 runtimes (macOS: the archives below). Checked on 2026-11-05 against the release r7 runtimes above: every license-like file they ship (2,103 files) is in this collection and mapped to its platform. The re-seals up to r7 changed only first-party files, except that Windows ARM64 route-runtime/git now holds the ARM64 PortableGit files already shipped under bundle/tools/git.
inputs.macos-arm64: macos-arm64-assets-20261102-r1: publisher/ACQUISITION.json and sources/SOURCES.sha256 (each archive checked by SHA-256 before reading); zsh-5.9.2.tar.xz of macos-arm64-assets-zsh-20261103-r1; fixed work data and web dependencies as shipped in the Linux aarch64 runtime

scope_limits: Chromium notices are in the separate Chromium/credits.html of the License folder.
Qt attribution lists cover all of qtbase; cmake-gui contains a subset.
Corresponding source is listed in SOURCE_AVAILABILITY.txt, not in this collection.

macOS mappings were made from the pinned publisher archives and sources before the macOS runtime was built and checked against the sealed macOS runtime afterwards. macOS ships only bin/cmake and share/cmake-4.4 of CMake.app (no cmake-gui or Qt), only bin/zsh of zsh (no shell functions) and only Tcl itself (no bundled pkgs/); its coreutils lib/posixtm.c carries a one-line cast (2026-11-03).
